details: This package is an install-time host-metadata beacon. Its preinstall hook runs index.js, which reads the machine's hostname and the current username, hex-encodes both, and issues an HTTPS GET to hxxps://accenture-npm[.]azurewebsites[.]net/test?h=<hex hostname>&u=<hex username>. The request carries no credentials, tokens, environment values or file contents — only the hostname and username. The package ships nothing else (a single 317-byte index.js) and declares version 99.99.2 on a scoped name that mimics an internal shared-UI package, the shape used to test whether an internal package name can be claimed on the public registry. IOC: hxxps://accenture-npm[.]azurewebsites[.]net/test
